issue_context.title: Add an EVP demo for EC key generation
issue_context.body:
Use a named curve and include a validation step as a separate function.

It should be the current best practice (fetch), have proper error handling and resource allocation/deallocation and be in the style of a known answer test.

review_comments: I'm unsure if the function being static makes sense or not.
Its a local function.. Why would it not be static?
It's a demo and this is the function that will be used (i.e. exported)
